label: Security
seo_description: Security architecture, encryption at rest and in transit, and access controls for RunMyCampus.
headline: Security by design.
subheadline: Encryption, tenant isolation, and access controls protect your school data.

segments.title: Architecture
segments.body: Subdomain tenant isolation; dedicated host contract for public, tenant, and manager surfaces.

segments.title: Encryption
segments.body: Encryption at rest and in transit; secrets and credentials managed securely.

segments.title: Access controls
segments.body: Role-based access and audit trails for all administrative and support actions.
